card.name: The before CNS in opioid-benzodiazepine warning
card.fires_on: The word "the" right before "CNS" in the sentence about benzodiazepines and opioids acting at different receptor sites. It also fires weakly on "at" in the next sentence about GABAA sites.

modes.label: the before CNS
modes.description: The word "the" after "receptor sites in" in the repeated opioid and benzodiazepine interaction sentence.
modes.example: The concomitant use of benzodiazepines and opioids increases the risk of respiratory depression because of actions at different receptor sites in<< the>> CNS that control respiration.

modes.label: at before GABAA
modes.description: The word "at" in the follow-on sentence about where benzodiazepines act.
modes.example: Benzodiazepines interact<< at>> GABAA sites, and opioids interact

card.writes: It slightly pushes toward brain and reward words such as limb, reward and dop, though the link is weak.
card.plain: It marks one repeated drug-interaction sentence, at the word just before CNS.
